image_description: A low-angle shot of a concrete staircase or platform edge featuring a metal handrail system. The railing consists of horizontal bars rather than traditional vertical balusters, mounted on short posts. Above the stairs is a concrete wall with a rectangular opening and a dark horizontal beam containing illegible text/signage. The sky is cloudy.
